target: current original SGBM optical depth absolute error >0.15m
consumer: confidence only; excluded points unknown, no free-space certificate or memory erasure
train: H complete E2; raw-forward/H identical physics one group
validation: V whole E2 descriptive; only suffix after first native physical-position divergence +10s is gate
features: current RGB paired patch texture/NCC/residual, original disparity/depth local gradients, current native camera registered height and disparity sensitivity; sensor packet membership carries existing CAD mask
truth: labels/scoring only; no future input; no position/frame/time as fitted features
model: single ridge logistic, 12 features, train-only mean/std, scipy L-BFGS-B maxiter150, lambda0.01, threshold P(bad)<0.5
fit_sampling: per-epoch sorted packet every8th point, deterministic; no validation sampling for scoring
failure: reject frozen model, no threshold/feature/model rescue; next distinct mechanism needs evidence
